newsitem.title: POLAND: SANITEC TO OPEN NEW POLISH PLANT.
newsitem.headline: SANITEC TO OPEN NEW POLISH PLANT.

text.p: Finnish bathroom ceramics maker Sanitec Ltd OY, part of the Metra engineering group, plans to open a new factory in Poland next year and double production in the country, the president of the firm's Polish unit said.
Marek Kukuryka told Reuters on Wednesday that the company would open a new $22 million factory in Poland next year producing sanitary bathroom ceramics.
Sanitec already has majority stakes in the Zaklady Wyrobow Sanitarnych Kolo sanitary ceramics maker, where it has invested $4.1 million, and in the Laminex bathtub maker.
Kukuryka said Sanitec's firms in Poland employ 500 and should lift sales to about 100 million zlotys this year from 34 milliion zlotys next year.
